description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various language models on the November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests, with scores normalized to a maximum of 150 and averaged over 100 runs at a temperature of 0.5. The horizontal axis lists the models, including Llama-3-3 70B instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4, arranged in ascending order of model size. The vertical axis represents the average score, ranging from 60 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by two adjacent bars: a light blue bar for the "Large model" category and a dark blue bar for the "Small model" category. The scores range from 66.4 for Llama-3-3 70B instruct to 91.8 for phi-4. Notably, phi-4 achieves the highest score among all models, significantly outperforming others in its weight class and even surpassing non-open-weight models, as highlighted in the caption. Error bars, representing two standard deviations of the estimate, are shown above each bar, indicating the variability in the performance measurements. The chart demonstrates that phi-4, despite being a small model, achieves exceptionally high performance, particularly in competition math tasks.
